item.title: Understanding and Interpreting User Search Queries from First Principles
item.description: I have always been interested in working on how search really works in depth, and this is a part of me trying to understand it in depth so that it can help me or, let’s say, somebody else also go through search as a beginner. But more importantly, it’s like a brain dump through which I’m going to get more clarity on the best way we can design a good search system.
